title: The Art of Magic: The Gathering - Zendikar

paragraphs.text: The Art of Magic: The Gathering - Zendikar is an art book that was published under Viz Media 's Perfect Square imprint in January 2016. It is a hardcover with 240 pages.
The book contains illustrations from the original Zendikar block and both sets from the Battle for Zendikar block , and 65,000 words of lore and story.

Plane Shift: Zendikar is a free supplement to The Art of Magic: The Gathering — Zendikar , designed to help Dungeons & Dragons -players take the world details and story seeds contained in that book and turn them into an exciting D&D campaign.
